blocks.meta: FOR TIME · 5 FLOORS · 5 stations then a run leg per floor · cap 28:00 · 60 lb / 2×45 lb / 52 lb
blocks.format: One clock. All 5 stations, then the leg — that is one floor. Numbers read floor 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5.
blocks.workRest: 5 run legs, 1.0 mi total. Floor 1 · 0.30 mi @ 7.5 · Floor 2 · 0.25 mi @ 8.0 · Floor 3 · 0.20 mi @ 8.5 · Floor 4 · 0.15 mi @ 9.0 · Floor 5 · 0.10 mi @ 9.5. No rest.
blocks.noteGreen: Finish 5 floors inside 28:00. Log your time, the station that slowed you most, and RPE.
blocks.text: Zercher: bell hugged high in the crook of the elbows, sit straight down, stand tall. Odd-load deadlift: one implement per hand, stay square, do not let the heavy side pull you over. Step-up: bench height, whole foot on top, drive through the heel.
